title: One to Two Month Residential Academic Research Fellowships
field: Research using the American Antiquarian Society library collections
about: The American Antiquarian Society's one to two month residential academic research fellowships are for research using the AAS library in Worcester, Massachusetts, United States. Most are open to doctoral candidates, some to postdoctoral scholars. Application deadline: January 15, 2027.
requirements: Most fellowships open to doctoral candidates; some reserved for postdoctoral scholars

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Research using the American Antiquarian Society library collections" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Most fellowships open to doctoral candidates; some reserved for postdoctoral scholars" → "Apply responsible practices for verification, attribution, citation awareness, confidentiality, and academic integrity when using AI in research activities."
